hooks.command: in=$(cat); printf %s "$in" | grep -qiE 'side ?note|(^|[^a-z])btw([^a-z]|$)' && echo 'User flagged a topic switch. If the previous thread is unfinished, answer this, then offer in one line to park it.'; printf %s "$in" | grep -qiE 'would be nice|nice to have|at some point|someday|down the line|feature idea|need (a )?new fea?ture' && echo 'User floated a side idea. Keep the current task; offer in one line to park the idea.'; true
